heading: INT. OLD LIBRARY - RARE BOOKS ROOM - EVENING

units.text: INT. OLD LIBRARY - RARE BOOKS ROOM - EVENING
A tall room of dark oak and leather.
A ladder on rails.
A reading table under a green lamp.
PROFESSOR HADLEIGH VANCE-OKONJO (50s, tweed, pipe unlit) examines a bound volume under magnification.
Across the table, his assistant MISS PRISCILLA TREVELYAN-ADE (30s, cardigan, pencil behind her ear) records notes.
In the corner, the librarian MR. OSWIN CHAMBERLAIN-BELL (70s, bow tie, white gloves) dusts a shelf.
Priscilla, look at this.
units.name: HADLEIGH

units.text: At what, Professor?
units.name: PRISCILLA

units.text: The binding. It has been recently altered.
units.name: HADLEIGH

units.text: Altered how?
units.name: PRISCILLA

units.text: The stitching. Someone has resewn the spine.
units.name: HADLEIGH

units.text: That is impossible. No one has touched that volume in forty years.
units.name: OSWIN

units.text: Forty-one, Mr. Chamberlain-Bell, according to your register.
units.name: HADLEIGH

units.text: Then forty-one.
units.name: OSWIN

units.text: Professor, there's a name here on the flyleaf.
units.name: PRISCILLA

units.text: Read it.
units.name: HADLEIGH

units.text: "Cornelius Ambrose Wren."
units.name: PRISCILLA

units.text: Wren?
units.name: OSWIN

units.text: You know the name.
units.name: HADLEIGH

units.text: He was a donor. Long dead.
units.name: OSWIN

units.text: He died in nineteen thirty-two.
units.name: HADLEIGH

units.text: Quite.
units.name: OSWIN

units.text: Then who has been writing in his book?
units.name: HADLEIGH

units.text: There's fresh ink in the margins.
units.name: PRISCILLA

units.text: That cannot be.
units.name: OSWIN

units.text: Here, Priscilla. Hold the lamp lower.
units.name: HADLEIGH

units.text: The ink is still wet.
units.name: PRISCILLA

units.text: Put it down.
units.name: OSWIN

units.text: Mr. Chamberlain-Bell.
units.name: HADLEIGH

units.text: Put it down at once.
units.name: OSWIN

units.text: ^What is it?
units.name: PRISCILLA

units.text: ^What do you know?
units.name: HADLEIGH

units.text: Oswin crosses the room with surprising speed, takes the volume in both gloved hands, and clasps it to his chest.
I know that some books are not meant to be read.
units.name: OSWIN

units.text: By whom?
units.name: HADLEIGH

units.text: By anyone.
units.name: OSWIN

units.text: Mr. Chamberlain-Bell, you wrote in it.
units.name: PRISCILLA

units.text: No, my dear. I have only been keeping it dry.
units.name: OSWIN

units.text: He lays the book on the table, opens it to a page, and steps back.
In the green lamplight, a line of handwriting slowly begins to appear on the paper, letter by letter.
Hadleigh and Priscilla lean in together.
